title: Arena Run
description: Survive rounds, choose 1 of 3 stacking upgrades, discover synergies and defeat bosses.

title: Horde
description: Increasing waves of bots with changing compositions and elite waves.

title: Gun Game
description: Every kill advances your weapon. Finish the ladder with the Gauntlet.

title: Boss Rush
description: Defeat a sequence of 10 increasingly modified bot bosses.

title: Wipeout Solo
description: Clear 5 squads. Bot respawn delays grow after each death; win a round by eliminating the whole squad at once.

title: The Gauntlet
description: Clear 10 seeded stages mixing weapon trials, survival fights, duel-like encounters and bosses.

title: Last Stand
description: Bots keep coming. You do not respawn. Score is kills and survival time.

title: Bounty Hunt
description: Eliminate 8 marked targets while the rest of the enemy squad interferes.

title: Rocket Tag
description: Rocket-only target chase: eliminate 10 marked targets.

title: Movement Hunter
description: Survive 90 seconds against armed bots using movement, routes and evasion.

title: Predator
description: Start fragile; kills restore health. Reach a 25-kill streak before dying.

title: Accuracy Trial
description: Clear 20 Lightning Gun kills, then review your final weapon accuracy.

title: Speedrun Combat
description: Clear 15 kills as fast as possible.

title: Random Loadout
description: Reach 20 kills while your curated weapon loadout rerolls every 4 kills and after each death.
